Our Little Memories ✨

A little something from my heart ✦
Happy Birthday Puchku ❤️🎂

Tum meri life mein kab itni important ban gayi, mujhe khud pata hi nahi chala. ❤️ Bas itna pata hai ki ab tumhari smile, tumhari awaaz, tumhari chhoti-chhoti baatein… sab kuch mere liye bahut matter karta hai. Tumhari khushi dekhkar mujhe bhi ek alag si khushi milti hai. 🥹❤️

Aur meri Puchku, kabhi preparation ke pressure mein thak jao, kabhi lage ki sab kuch mushkil ho raha hai, ya kabhi khud par doubt aaye… toh bas ek baat yaad rakhna—

Tum bas apna 100% do, baaki main sambhaal lunga. ❤️

Har waqt strong rehna zaroori nahi hai. Kabhi thak jao toh thoda ruk jaana, mujhse baat kar lena… apni saari tension mujhe bata dena. Main hoon, aur jitna ho sakega, tumhare saath khada rahunga. 🫶🏻❤️

— Tumhara ❤️
